margin_rule_sources: Cboe Rule 10.3(c)(5), as described in SEC Release 34-97019 / 88 FR 14416 (2023-03-08): "a margin deposit for short cash-settled index options in an amount equal to 100% of the current market value of the option plus 15% (if overlying a broad-based index) ... of the amount equal to the index value multiplied by the index multiplier minus the amount, if any, by which the option is out-of-the-money. The minimum margin required for such an option is 100% of the option current market value plus 10% of the index value multiplied by the index multiplier for a call or 10% of the exercise price multiplied by the index multiplier for a put."

Cboe "Strategy-based Margin" page (cboe.com/markets/us/options/margin/strategy-based-margin), Short Put and Short Call, initial requirement: "short put or short call requirement, whichever is greater, plus the option proceeds of the other side."
